rationale: The momentum-continuation thesis has stalled: after a brief 0.62% MFE the price has faded back to breakeven and now sits just below the 5m 9-EMA ($30.59) after five flat bars that resolved lower on the session's largest recent 1m volume (1.29M). Price remains above VWAP ($30.37) and the tape is risk-on (SPY +1.06%), but with no fresh highs and short-term momentum rolling over, the edge has decayed enough to exit flat rather than hold dead money; there is insufficient evidence to justify flipping short against a strong gap-up name.
